UPW Kedzie Station Construction
Due to construction, the east end of platform 2 (south platform) at Kedzie will be closed until the end of October. Please use caution near the work area during this time. Updates will be provided.

Major Rock Island Line Construction Begins the Evening of Friday, August 21

Major Rock Island construction begins the evening of Friday, August 21. Evening train cancellations are posted on Metra.com. There will be no train service on August 22 and 23. Visit Metra.com or MetraTracker.com to plan alternate travel.

UPN - Rogers Park ADA Accessibility Wednesday, July 22

Due to scheduled ramp repairs, the Rogers Park station will not be ADA accessible on Wednesday, July 22. Customers can use Peterson/Ridge and Main Street/Evanston as alternate boarding stations. Accessibility will be restored on Thursday, July 23.

UPN Kenosha Elevator Out of Service
The Kenosha elevator is out of service. Customers can use Zion or Winthrop Harbor as alternate boarding stations.

Milwaukee District North Major Track Project Affecting Midday Service Aug 3 - Oct 23

August 3 - October 23, track work to replace 4.5 miles of rail will affect midday service between Fox Lake and Lake Forest. Passengers boarding at these stations should utilize alternate Metra lines or other transportation. Visit metra.com for more info.

BNSF Harlem Avenue Station Closed Due to Construction from August 6 thru August 15
Beginning Thursday, August 6 through Saturday, August 15, the Harlem Avenue station will close due to road construction. Passengers must board trains at Berwyn or Riverside during this period.

RID - 115th St./Morgan Park Station Construction

The north/south parking lots at the 115th St/Morgan Park station are now open to the public and ADA accessibility has been restored. Station construction is expected to continue through Spring 2027. Metra will provide updates once construction is complete.

BNSF - July 22, 2026 - Brookfield Station Parking Restrictions and Road Closures

Wednesday, July 22, the village of Brookfield will be hosting the Cycle Brookfield Criterium. Street closures and parking restrictions will be in effect. BNSF commuters should allow additional time when heading to the Brookfield station.
